gen-gf-phudu-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Encode Sans Expanded spreads out wide and friendly, its c shapes holding their tips well apart. Encode Sans Expanded in paragraphs feels like a plain sans that never crowds you, a steady counterweight to Phudu's pipe-cleaner strokes.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-encode-sans-sc:
Phudu is bold, with every curve left generously open.

It has no calligraphic thinning anywhere, just plain ballpoint-weight lines, while Encode Sans SC does the quieter work, with a shallow terminal curl and a wide gap that suit sustained text.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-encode-sans-semi-expande:
Encode Sans Semi Expanded has rounded letters left open and easy.

Phudu's flat, unvarying line weight in every letter sits next to them like a loud friend beside a contemporary, quiet one.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-exo: Crisp and approachable, Exo keeps wide gaps that hold up even at tiny sizes. Exo carries a long page in a plain sans without fuss, while Phudu's hairline-free, swell-free letterforms handle the shouting.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-exo-2: Phudu has a pipe-cleaner look, bold and distinctive, with generous openings on every curve. Exo 2 is the sans that does the opposite job, its curves holding plenty of daylight inside for the text.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-faculty-glyphic: Phudu looks like glass tubing bent into letters, bold and a touch strange. And Faculty Glyphic follows in modern sans-serif form, its rounded letters clearly opened so a long passage goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-fahkwang: Fahkwang reads like a plain sans with a faint nib-pressure shift in each round letter, curves finishing well before they close. But if Phudu, a plain stripe of constant ink, were made small, it would lose the generous openings that make it distinctive.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-figtree:
Marker-tip friendliness meets bold display swagger.

Phudu's generous openings take the top, and Figtree, a modern sans with a wide gap at the e's terminal, settles in below to carry the words.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-fustat: Phudu is bold and distinctive, with generous openings on every curve and a pressure-free ballpoint line. Fustat follows as a plain sans of bent-rope lines, its c ending in a clear wide gap that keeps a long page moving.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-gantari: Phudu's pressure-free, ballpoint-plain line gives it a bold, open look on every curve. And Gantari feels wire-bent across the whole word, its wide c apertures making a sans that sits comfortably beside such a loud neighbor.
